results.title: Robert Luna - Ballotpedia
results.content:
Robert Luna is the Los Angeles County Sheriff in California. Luna assumed office on December 5, 2022. Luna's current term ends on December 7, 2026.

Luna is running for re-election for Los Angeles County Sheriff in California. Luna is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026). Luna advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026).

results.title: Robert Luna - Wikipedia
results.content:
Robert G. Luna is an American law enforcement officer who has served as the sheriff of Los Angeles County since 2022. He previously served as chief of the Long Beach Police Department "Long Beach Police Department (California)") from 2014 to 2021, before defeating Sheriff Alex Villanueva in the 2022 election.

results.title: L.A. County sheriff's race last-minute guide: Luna vs. Villanueva - Los Angeles Times
results.content:
Incumbent Robert Luna is a former Long Beach police chief who came out of retirement to run for sheriff in 2021 and unseated Alex Villanueva in the November 2022 election. Luna has presided over declines in homicides and violent crime as well as establishing a period of relative calm after Villanueva’s tenure, which was marked by controversy and scandal.
